attchmntText: Apex Frozen Foods Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Apex Frozen Foods Limited announced the approval of its Un-Audited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026, by the Board of Directors on 12th November, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 2,378.12 Lakhs for the half-year period. Revenue from operations stood at 53,739.66 Lakhs. The results include an exceptional provision of 935.92 Lakhs for incremental Anti-Dumping Duty liability. The company also declared a final dividend of Rs.2.50 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/S. Padmanabhan Ramani & Ramanujam, Chartered Accountants.

attchmntText: Apex Frozen Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Apex Frozen Foods Limited has scheduled a conference call to discuss financial performance for the second quarter and first half ended 30th September, 2026. The call is set for Monday, 16th November, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. The announcement was issued on 11th November, 2026. Karuturi Subrahmanya Chowdary, Managing Director and CFO, signed the intimation. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange with scrip code 540692 and on the National Stock Exchange with symbol APEX.
